fact: The Cameroon Climate Innovation Hub (CAMCIH), an NGO housed at ICT University in Yaounde, was officially launched as an incubation and collaboration platform, with training programmes still planned.

Douala Tech Park, launched in October 2024 at the Institut JFN with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure and Dassault Systemes backing, aims to train 10,000 talents by 2030; no startup programme is stated.
Douala and Yaounde host new accelerators such as ActivSpaces and international hubs such as Orange Fab, per TechCabal.
Hubs and incubators are named in Douala, Yaounde and Buea (ActivSpaces, SM Ventures), per TechCabal.
UNDP's report on CITS 2026 says Mountain Hub, the summit organiser, will give a six-month incubation support to the second-prize Science-to-Business initiative, with no cohort programme described.

Africtelegraph reports the Douala Tech Park technology centre was inaugurated in October 2024 on the JFN Hightech University Institute campus in Douala, with training, prototyping, incubation and acceleration infrastructure already operational, but names no programme or cohort of startups.

Cameroon's higher-education minister inaugurated the Centre d'Incubation des Innovations et des Entreprises Digitales of the Inter-State University Congo-Cameroon on 13 March 2025, a FCFA 450 million CEMAC FODEC-funded building offering student-entrepreneurs support, with four startups presenting projects, and no cohort programme stated.

fact: Enovation Factory, a Cameroon-based incubator and accelerator, with UNDP Cameroon launched Scale 32, a 14-month programme of training, mentorship and workspace for 32 tech startups in two 2026 cohorts, with 12 months of alumni support.

EcoMatin reports that Orange Digital Center's OrangeFab acceleration programme, launched in 2022, presented its third cohort of seven startups at an Innovation Day in Douala on 4 June 2025 after six months of coaching.
The Nkafu Policy Institute paper names the Silicon Mountain hub in Buea and the upcoming Silicon River hub in Yaounde, with no programme described.
